ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, point O is at the upper left. Beside O is marked the initial velocity v0, with the arrow horizontally to the right; from O to point P at the lower right there is an inclined straight line OP; at the height where point P is located, a horizontal dashed line is drawn, and the angle 37° is marked between OP and this horizontal line. Reasoning: Let the horizontal displacement of the athlete from O to P be x, and the vertical falling height be y. From the geometric relation in the figure, y/x = tan37° = sin37°/cos37° = 0.6/0.8 = 3/4. In horizontal projectile motion, x = v0 t, y = gt^2/2, so (gt^2/2)/(v0 t) = 3/4, obtaining gt/v0 = 3/2. When reaching point P, the horizontal velocity vx = v0, and the vertical velocity vy = gt = 3v0/2. Therefore the square of the velocity at point P is v0^2 + (3v0/2)^2 = 13v0^2/4. Kinetic energy is proportional to the square of velocity, so the ratio of the kinetic energy when reaching point P to the kinetic energy when thrown from point O is (13v0^2/4)/v0^2 = 13/4.

raw_record.question_text: At the end of July 2015, the International Olympic Committee voted to select Beijing as the host city for the 2022 Winter Olympics. Ski jumping is one of the competition events of the Winter Olympics. Ski jumping can be abstracted as horizontal projectile motion on an inclined slope. As shown in the figure, suppose that a skier who can be regarded as a particle is thrown horizontally from the top O of the slope with initial velocity v0, and just passes through point P during the motion. OP makes an angle of 37° with the horizontal direction. Neglect air resistance, and sin 37°=0.6, cos 37°=0.8. Find the ratio of the kinetic energy of the skier when reaching point P to the kinetic energy when thrown from point O.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出：O 在左上方，运动员从 O 点以水平向右的初速度 v0 抛出；P 在右下方，OP 是一条向下倾斜的直线，P 点处画有水平虚线，OP 与水平线夹角为 37°。再结合题文“平抛运动、不计空气阻力、sin37°=0.6、cos37°=0.8”。设从 O 到 P 的水平位移为 x、竖直下落高度为 y。由图中几何关系 y/x=tan37°=0.6/0.8=3/4。平抛运动满足 x=v0 t，y=gt^2/2，因此 (gt^2/2)/(v0 t)=3/4，得 gt/v0=3/2。到 P 点时速度分量为 vx=v0，vy=gt=3v0/2，所以动能比为 [m(vx^2+vy^2)/2]/[mv0^2/2]=(v0^2+(3v0/2)^2)/v0^2=13/4。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中 O 点在左上方，O 旁标有初速度 v0，箭头水平向右；从 O 到右下方的 P 点有一条倾斜直线 OP；P 点所在高度处画有水平虚线，OP 与该水平线之间标出夹角 37°。推理：设运动员从 O 到 P 的水平位移为 x，竖直下落高度为 y。由图中几何关系，y/x = tan37° = sin37°/cos37° = 0.6/0.8 = 3/4。平抛运动中，x = v0 t，y = gt^2/2，所以 (gt^2/2)/(v0 t) = 3/4，得到 gt/v0 = 3/2。到达 P 点时，水平速度 vx = v0，竖直速度 vy = gt = 3v0/2。因此 P 点速度平方为 v0^2 + (3v0/2)^2 = 13v0^2/4。动能与速度平方成正比，所以到达 P 点时的动能与从 O 点抛出时的动能比值为 (13v0^2/4)/v0^2 = 13/4。
